description: Search a directory of Taiwanese metal material and processing suppliers; companies registered on eMetals AI™ are listed first. Filter by company name, material or city; material and city accept English or Chinese (e.g. "stainless" or 不鏽鋼, "Changhua" or 彰化縣). Returns company name, district, material and process categories, and a url to the company page on emetals.tw. Phone numbers, emails and full addresses are not included; contact goes through the emetals.tw page. 搜尋台灣金屬材料與加工供應商名錄（已入駐的優先）；回傳公司名、縣市區域、類別與公司頁網址，不含電話、email 與完整地址。

city.description: City or county, e.g. Tainan, Changhua, 彰化縣 / 縣市

keyword.description: Company name keyword / 公司名關鍵字

material.description: Material, e.g. stainless, aluminum, copper, carbon steel, 不鏽鋼 / 材質
